```{r, message = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
#library(escape)
library(msigdbr)

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(gridExtra)

#library(Nebulosa)

data_storage_folder = file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/PySCENIC_IM_only")

result_folder = "../../../../Results/Zhang_scRNA/PySCENIC_IM_only/"
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)
```
# Overview

This analysis is based on a PySCENIC analysis of the full data set of Zhang et al gastric samples

```{r}
load(file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA", "Zhang_all_cells_CCA.RData"))
meta <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/Zhang_all_cells_CCA_metadata.rds")
scData <- scData.combined
rm(scData.combined)
scData@meta.data <- meta[Cells(scData),]
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
scData <- SetIdent(scData, value="cluster_label")
DimPlot(scData, label=T) + NoLegend()
```


```{r}
n="Zhang_IM"
pyscenic_res = read.table(file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/PySCENIC_IM_only",paste0(n,"/auc_mtx.csv")), sep=",", header=T)
colnames(pyscenic_res) = gsub("\\.\\.\\.", "", colnames(pyscenic_res))
```

# Score distribution overview

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
all_tf_names = colnames(pyscenic_res)[2:ncol(pyscenic_res)]
par(mfrow=c(4,4))
tmp = mapply(function(x,n) hist(x, breaks=100, main=n, xlab="Score", xlim=c(0,1)), pyscenic_res[, all_tf_names], all_tf_names)
```

# Overview of TF activity in across clusters

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7, warning=FALSE}
tmp = pyscenic_res[, 2:ncol(pyscenic_res)]
rownames(tmp) = pyscenic_res$Cell
scores_ordered = tmp[Cells(scData),]

scData <- SetIdent(scData, value="cluster_label")

all_new_cols = c()
for (n in all_tf_names) {
  nc = paste0(n,"_score")
  scData <- AddMetaData(scData, scores_ordered[, n], col.name = nc)
  all_new_cols = append(all_new_cols, nc)
  
  p1 = FeaturePlot(scData, features = nc, order=T, raster=T)
  p2 = VlnPlot(scData, features=nc, pt.size = 0.01) + NoLegend()
  #p3 = plot_density(scData, nc)
  #layout_matrix = matrix(c(1,2,1,3),2,2)
  #grid.arrange(grobs = list(p2,p1,p3),ncol=2,nrow=2, layout_matrix = layout_matrix)
  print(plot_grid(p1,p2,ncol=2))
}

```

# UMAP

## UMAP on all clusters including stromal cells

```{r}
if(F) {
  ab = Seurat::RunUMAP(as.matrix(scores_ordered))  
  saveRDS(ab, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "UMAP_on_TF_complete_DS.rds"), compress = T)
} else {
  ab = readRDS(file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "UMAP_on_TF_complete_DS.rds"))  
}
scData@reductions$pyscenic = ab
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
scData <- SetIdent(scData, value="cluster_label")
scData$condition = factor(scData$condition, levels=c("Non-atrophic gastritis","Chronic atrophic gastritis", "Mild intestinal metaplasia","Severe intestinal metaplasia", "Early gastric cancer"))
DimPlot(scData, reduction = "pyscenic", label=T) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(scData, reduction = "pyscenic", label=T, split.by = "condition", ncol = 3) + NoLegend()
```

## UMAP only on non-stromal/immune clusters, no GC

```{r}
meta = scData@meta.data
sel_cells = subset(meta, (cluster_type =="Epi" & !(condition == "Early gastric cancer") ) )
sel_cell_ids = rownames(sel_cells)
sel_cell_ids = sel_cell_ids[sel_cell_ids %in% rownames(scores_ordered)]
tmp =as.matrix(scores_ordered[sel_cell_ids, ])

if(FALSE) {
  ab_filtered = Seurat::RunUMAP(tmp)
  saveRDS(ab_filtered, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "UMAP_on_TF_epithelial_only.rds"), compress=T)
} else {
  ab_filtered = readRDS(file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "UMAP_on_TF_epithelial_only.rds"))
}

scData_filtered = subset(scData, cells = sel_cell_ids)
scData_filtered@reductions$pyscenic = ab_filtered
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
scData_filtered$condition = factor(scData_filtered$condition, levels=c("Non-atrophic gastritis","Chronic atrophic gastritis", "Mild intestinal metaplasia","Severe intestinal metaplasia"))
DimPlot(scData_filtered, reduction = "pyscenic", label=T) + NoLegend()


DimPlot(scData_filtered, reduction = "pyscenic", label=T, split.by = "condition") + NoLegend()
```

```{r}
set.seed(20240430)
scData_filtered <- FindNeighbors(scData_filtered, reduction = "pyscenic", graph.name = c("pyscenic_nn", "pyscenic_snn"), dims = 1:2 )
scData_filtered <- FindClusters(scData_filtered, graph.name = "pyscenic_snn", resolution = 0.05)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(scData_filtered, reduction = "pyscenic", label=T)
```

# DE

```{r}
library(limma)

inp_mat = as.matrix(scores_ordered[Cells(scData_filtered),])

cluster = paste0("C",scData_filtered@meta.data[rownames(inp_mat), "seurat_clusters"] )

TS = factor(cluster)

design <- model.matrix(~0+TS)
colnames(design) = gsub("^TS","", colnames(design))

fit <- lmFit(t(inp_mat), design)
contrast.matrix <- makeContrasts(C5.4 = C5-C4,
                                 C5.3 = C5-C3,
                                 C5.2 = C5-C2,
                                 C5.1 = C5-C1,
                                 C5.0 = C5-C0,
                                 C1.3 = C1-C3, 
                                 C1.2 = C1-C2, 
                                 C1.4 = C1-C4,
                                 C1.0 = C1-C0,
                                 levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

results <- decideTests(fit2, lfc = 0.07)

ab = topTable(fit2, number = ncol(inp_mat))

```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
aa = as.data.frame(results)
aa_sig = aa[apply(abs(aa), 1, max)>0, ]
pheatmap(as.matrix(aa_sig), fontsize_row = 8 )

```
